display_name: Utility wire span 30 m (3 catenary conductors)

axes.note: Blender axes; FBX recipe maps +Y(left) -> UE -Y

lod_info: Nanite-ready opaque mesh; no manual LODs (UE auto)
usage: Origin = the pole centreline at crossarm-insulator-top height, i.e. spawn it at pole_base + (0, 0, 8.654) (sidecar extra.place_at_pole_base_offset); the conductors then start exactly on the insulator tops of rs_utility_pole_9m (y = -0.9 / +0.9 on the crossarm, y = 0 and +0.63 m on the pole-top insulator) and end 30 m along +X (next pole at +30 m, extra.next_pole_offset). Sag 0.70 m. Rotate about Z to follow the line; scale X 0.9-1.1 re-aims it (sag scales with it). No collision.
uv: UVMap = metric box projection (1 UV unit = 1 m) for tiling materials; vertex colour Col = per-part tint (white default)
